subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should OpenClaw's browser `snapshot` action become visible-viewport scoped after scroll, or should visible viewport state be exposed as a separate browser read mode?
rationale: Current code supports multiple snapshot backends and current docs only promise a stable UI tree, so automation cannot safely choose the public contract or compatibility story.

options.title: Add explicit visible-viewport snapshot
options.body: Introduce visible viewport output with scroll metadata while keeping full-tree snapshot behavior available for compatibility.

options.title: Redefine existing snapshot
options.body: Change `snapshot` itself to mean current viewport, accepting that docs, tests, and any full-tree escape hatch must be updated together.

options.title: Keep full-tree semantics
options.body: Document current full-tree behavior and route viewport-only needs to screenshots or a future browser context redesign.

recommendation.title: Add explicit visible-viewport snapshot
recommendation.body: Introduce visible viewport output with scroll metadata while keeping full-tree snapshot behavior available for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the snapshot helper and route files where the contract would be implemented.
